# Test fixtures

`FMEMO.DBF` and `FMEMO.DBT` were generated by Clipper 5.2e running
under the oracle described in `docs/CLIPPER_ORACLE.md`. They are this
project's own output, not third-party material, and carry the
repository's licence.

The generating program is reproduced in `memo_test.go`. The five
records deliberately cover:

| CODE  | Case |
| ----- | ---- |
| SHORT | a memo fitting in one block |
| EMPTY | no memo: the pointer field is blank, no block allocated |
| SPAN  | 700 bytes, spanning two blocks |
| CTRL  | text containing a literal 0x1A, which must not be mistaken for the terminator |
| LAST  | the final memo, whose terminator sits at end of file |
